definitions.explanation: A facility where waste, sewage, or other materials are processed or treated, typically for disposal or recycling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Sewage is cleaned at the wastewater treatment plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I toured the waste processing plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Construction of a new processing plant is being planned.

notes:
{処理場|しょりじょう} is a compound of ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (processing/treatment) and {場|じょう} (place/facility). It refers to a facility where waste or sewage is processed, treated, or disposed of.

TYPES:
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}: sewage treatment plant
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}: waste processing facility
- ⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}: wastewater treatment plant
- ⟦{食肉|しょくにく}→食肉：24201_shokuniku⟧{処理場|しょりじょう}: meat processing plant

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process, to treat
- ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: facility (broader term)
- {浄水場|じょうすいじょう}: water purification plant

USAGE:
The suffix {場|じょう} (not {所|じょ}) marks the word as a large-scale facility. Compare with {処理所|しょりじょ}, which is rarely used.
